leadText: Morgan (Japanese: ルミタン Lematin) is one of the four of the Battle Maison in Pokémon X, Y, Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire, alongside her sisters Nita, Evelyn, and Dana.
plainText:
Morgan (Japanese: ルミタン Lematin) is one of the four of the Battle Maison in Pokémon X, Y, Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire, alongside her sisters Nita, Evelyn, and Dana.

==In the core series games==
Morgan is the leader of the Rotation Battle format of the Battle Maison, as well as the eldest of the sisters. Morgan can be battled once the has acquired a 19-win streak. She can later be battled on the Super Rotation Battle once the player has acquired a 49-win streak.

Morgan may also appear alongside Evelyn in the Multi Battle format after the player as attained a 19-win streak. She will randomly send out two of the four Pokémon from her Rotation Battle team. In the Super Multi Battle format, Morgan may be battled alongside Nita after the player has reached a 49-win streak. She will randomly send out two of the four Pokémon from her Super Rotation Battle team.

===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Morgan forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Morgan became a playable sync pair on August 28, 2024.
